    • setText

      public boolean setText(int index, String text)
      Sets the text of the header & footer at the specified index. The text is to "<<1>>", and the starting value of the page number is the set pageOffset. eg: When text is set to "<<1>>" and the value of pageOffset is 1, the text displayed on the first page is "1".
      Parameters:
      index - The specified index
      text - The display text
      Returns:
      Whether the setting is successful

    • setRules

      public boolean setRules(int rule)
      When setText setText(int, String), there are two kinds of rules. When rule is 1, the set text is in the form of <<i>> or <<i,f>>, where 'i' is the starting value of the page number, and 'f' is the number of digits in the page number, if the actual page number is not enough, it will be automatically filled with 0 in front. When rule is 2, the set text is <<1>>, and the starting value of the page number is the set pageOffset.
      Parameters:
      rule - rule, default is 2
      Returns:
      Whether the setting is successful
